Worth the trip
Mar 2026 • Friends
An evening at the San Fu Lou branch of Le Lai offers a full Cantonese food experience. The ambience is cozy, luxurious yet comfortable, perfect for family or friends. The hot dimsum dishes, fresh marshmallows, and crispy ducks are especially impressive, with a taste of taste. The waitstaff is agile, courteous, and always ready to advise. Time to go fast, even though it’s busy. The price is a little higher than the general parity, but it deserves the quality of the food and service received. Definitely will be back.

New Festival Menu at Trefu Restaurant
Jul 2025 • Friends
Recently, my friend and I have tried a new menu at San Fu Lou - Three Fruit House restaurant called “Hải Vị Thượng Phẩm”. Feels especially delicious to try with everyone recommend, comments. I ordered a flavored fish slice and an aromatic ball cooker.
Burning fish is especially fresh, the taste is delicious, and the fish meat is soft inside. The balls are hot and fragrant, and the spicy taste is special.
The price of this menu is also reasonable, and we strongly recommend visiting friends who like wide cuisine or want to try different flavors.
